capabilities: Export a canvas to multiple formats in a single action
Convert canvas structure into Excalidraw, Mermaid, or D2 diagrams
Render PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, and PDF exports with light, dark, or Obsidian-matched themes
Configure output folder, overwrite behavior, image scale, and background options
Re-run the last export with saved settings
extras: Desktop-only: image and PDF rendering use Electron APIs, so it will not run on mobile. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Privacy-wise it runs locally with no accounts, telemetry, or external API calls.
intentEvidence: a substantially modified derivative of Canvas Export by Robin Moffatt
problem: Obsidian Canvas files are hard to share or reuse outside Obsidian, and exporting them to common visual or diagram formats is not supported by the core Canvas feature.

relations.evidence: CanvasPort is a substantially modified derivative of Canvas Export by Robin Moffatt.

summary: Canvas export plugin that converts Obsidian Canvas files into self-contained HTML, PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, PDF, Excalidraw, Mermaid, or D2 files locally.
